scope: Online research and export comparison with stored 2026-10-04 source snapshots. AA numeric comparison is limited to the 27 rows embedded in the current models page; vendor evidence remains separate from organizer scores. LiveBench 2.0 official application bundle, current exports and methodology have also been verified; FrontierMath v2 importer coverage has been audited.

rawNotes: Each cell is the model's mean task score for the suite, 0–100, from a single run.
Design: layout and design tasks across presentations, PDFs and documents. Graded on visual and structural checks of the produced file.
Research: open-ended research briefs producing a written report. Graded against a rubric.

Browser Use: multi-step tasks in working web applications, completed through a real browser. Scored as the share of tasks passed. A model that cannot accept screenshots cannot do these tasks and scores 0.
Coding: bug-fix tasks taken from real merged pull requests on a frozen codebase. Deterministic grading; a fix that breaks existing behaviour scores 0.

Agentic: long-running work — applications extended over several turns of changing requirements, operations on an existing codebase over simulated months or weeks, and extended coding and optimisation tasks. Deterministic grading.

Data Analysis: short data-analysis questions on small tables — finding runs of consecutive growth, mapping the columns of one table onto another, and converting a table between formats — each with a single correct answer, graded against ground truth. Each question costs far less than an agentic task.
Reasoning: short logic, spatial and theory-of-mind questions, each with a single correct answer, graded against ground truth. Each question costs far less than an agentic task.
Models run at their highest supported effort setting. Where a different setting was used, it is shown in the model's expanded row.
Overall is the mean of the suites a model has a score for. Blank and n/a cells are left out. Every suite counts equally.
